task.title: Start canonical Phase N6: record the owner ratification of VA-0 to VA-16 with C1-C5 (N6.1), clarify VA-9 packaged enforcement, add the N6.3 cross-process gate and implement the first slice N6.2 pure visual assertion policy
task.objective: Record the owner's explicit acceptance of C1-C5 and ratification of VA-0 to VA-16 as amended (design decisions, not verified implementation; the historical closure QC stays CHANGES REQUIRED; independent implementation and security QC stays mandatory under N6.8), close awkit-vra.15.1, clarify the flag versus step mode versus build availability distinction in VA-0, VA-8, VA-9 and VA-16 (packaged enforce always fails visual-unverified enforce-unavailable-in-production, never becomes a passing observe step), record a mandatory N6.3 cross-process safety gate (folderWriteCoordinator is process-local; packaged and non-packaged builds share flow storage and epoch tokens) with deterministic two-process verification, and implement N6.2 awkit-vra.15.2: the pure src/visual/assertion/decideVisualAssertion.ts with the ratified passed, failed and inconclusive verdicts and fixed reason codes over caller-supplied facts (refusals, N0 capture codes, baseline status, both conditions envelopes, geometry, clipping, hover and focus, precomputed commitments) with no key, HMAC, I/O, clock or randomness, exported through src/visual/index.ts, plus a new verify:visual-assertion with an observed-red mutation contract. No runner, recorder, IPC, persistence, report or UI change and no new src/visual import edge.

acceptance.description: DECISIONS records the owner's acceptance of C1-C5 and ratification of VA-0 to VA-16 as design decisions, keeps the closure QC as CHANGES REQUIRED and N6.8 independent QC mandatory, the plan reads RATIFIED / IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZED with the VA-9 clarification and the N6.3 cross-process gate, awkit-vra.15.1 is closed through bd and exported, dependencies preserved and awkit-vra.16 open.

The pure decideVisualAssertion exists with no I/O, key, clock, randomness or import outside src/visual, is exported only through src/visual/index.ts, passes only on validated equal conditions, geometry, state and exact commitment equality, fails only on a proven size or commitment difference under equal conditions, maps every other input (including unknown codes, unsupported versions and malformed input) to inconclusive, and verify:visual-assertion passes with every listed mutation observed red; visual isolation is unchanged at three edges.

awkit-vra.15.2 is closed, the epic is in progress, the new verifier is classified and documented, the dashboard pins match the measured counts and report Sources agree, source hygiene and git diff --check pass.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.
